subject: Post-demo: Tenant lockdown expectations & deployment tradeoffs
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Davis <claire.davis@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Tenant lockdown expectations & deployment tradeoffs

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a short set of qualification questions so we can scope the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC). I want to make sure we align on the data isolation guarantees you need before I pull in infra & legal.

Call highlights:
- Primary workload: inference on clinical notes and patient metadata for routing & summarization (some PHI).
- Peak QPS: ~30 concurrent inference requests, median prompt length ~400 tokens.
- SLA/latency: 95th percentile target ~200ms/token.

Deciding factors we discussed that affect whether Dedicated or Private is appropriate:
1) Data residency & egress: is any outbound transfer off your VPC/account forbidden?
2) Key control: BYOK required (customer-managed KMS) or OK with Redwood KMS?
3) Hardware exclusivity: do you require single-tenant physical hosts?
4) Control plane residency & audit: must the control plane be in your network or is a private control plane acceptable?
5) Evidence & timelines: SOC 2 artifacts, encrypted audit logs — required for procurement?

Could you reply with quick answers to the matrix I attached (deployment-needs-matrix.csv)? If easier, two one-line answers to these: PHI? (yes/no), BYOK? (yes/no), Egress prohibited? (yes/no), Control plane on-prem/VPC required? (yes/no), Target POC start window?

Proposed next steps after your answers:
- If BYOK + egress prohibited + control plane in your VPC => Private deployment (we’ll involve Private onboarding & legal).
- If BYOK + single-tenant but control plane ok in Redwood VPC => Dedicated with customer KMS and peered network (faster POC).

I’ll pull Ben in on the next message to outline the minimal network/firewall configuration and an estimated cost range for a 6-week POC.

Thanks,

— Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Claire Davis <claire.davis@healthsync.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Tenant lockdown expectations & deployment tradeoffs

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers below (filled from our security & infra leads):
- PHI: Yes (clinical notes include identifiers).
- BYOK: Yes — MANDATORY. Keys must be in our AWS account (KMS).
- Egress prohibited: We cannot allow model outputs or any derived artifacts to leave our VPC without explicit approval.
- Control plane: Prefer private control plane in our VPC; if not possible in time for the POC, we could accept a hybrid where control plane runs in Redwood but data plane (inference) is entirely in our VPC.
- POC start window: We want to start POC by Nov 15, 2026.

Can you also provide a ballpark for POC costs and an estimated timeline for a Private deployment vs Dedicated? We need this for procurement.

Claire Davis
Head of Data & Integrations | HealthSync
claire.davis@healthsync.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Davis <claire.davis@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Tenant lockdown expectations & deployment tradeoffs

Claire —

Appreciate the clarity — that helps a lot. Two quick items:

1) High-level recommendation based on your answers:
   - Short POC & faster time-to-value: Dedicated single-tenant pool with customer-managed KMS + VPC peering. This preserves BYOK and keeps inference data in your VPC while letting our control plane remain in Redwood (hybrid).
   - If control-plane residency in your VPC is non-negotiable for production, we’ll move to Private (private control plane + air-gapped option). Private typically requires a longer legal/onboarding runway but gives full isolation.

2) POC cost & timeline (very rough estimates):
   - Dedicated POC (4–6 weeks): ~$9k–$15k for reserved capacity & setup (depends on GPU type and network egress mitigations).
   - Private POC (6–10 weeks): ~$25k–$45k (onboarding, secure control plane setup, legal & audit prep).

I’ve attached an initial-poc-cost-estimates.xlsx and the deployment-needs-matrix.csv you requested. Ben — can you outline minimal network requirements and an onboarding checklist? Also want to confirm we can support BYOK with customer KMS in the POC.

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute technical alignment next week with your infra and our Private onboarding lead. Available windows: Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Best,
— Grace
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Davis <claire.davis@healthsync.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Tenant lockdown expectations & deployment tradeoffs — technical notes

Forwarding technical notes + checklist.

On 2026-10-01 11:30, Grace O'Connor wrote:
> Claire —
>
> Appreciate the clarity — that helps a lot. Two quick items:

Technical summary (minimal set for Dedicated POC with BYOK + VPC peering):
- Network:
  - VPC peering & private IP routes to Redwood inference subnet (no public internet for inference hosts).
  - Allow outbound connections to Redwood artifact repo for initial provisioning (we can do an allowlist).
  - Optional: PrivateLink for control-plane calls if you want no public endpoints.
- Key management:
  - Customer-managed KMS; Redwood will be granted a crypto role to wrap/unwrap tokens. Keys remain in your AWS account.
- Data handling:
  - KV cache zeroed on pod termination, optional prefix caching disabled for PHI workloads.
  - Logs: encrypted audit logs delivered to your S3 bucket (we’ll send delivery policy & sample).
- Evidence:
  - Attaching soc2-snapshot.pdf and private-onboarding-checklist.pdf showing docs we typically provide.

If you truly require the control plane to be inside your network for production, Private onboarding checklist items include: physical host affinity, dedicated control-plane VMs, hardened bastion + HSM integration for KMS. That path adds legal and infra lead time.

Next step: Grace, can we schedule a 30-min tech alignment with HealthSync infra (tom & Claire) and our Private onboarding lead (I can join) — proposed: Wed Oct 6, 11am PT?

Regards,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: soc2-snapshot.pdf (evidence stub), private-onboarding-checklist.pdf (onboarding doc), deployment-needs-matrix.csv, initial-poc-cost-estimates.xlsx
